text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria got injured during training, 
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's just a slight sprain. I'm 
fine, really!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all, not one bit♪ ...Come on now, 
left, right, left, right!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: And then... twi～rl!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
See, full of energy now! Now, now, let's 
head back to the track~!

Even so, you should rest today

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
See, full of energy now! Now, now, let's 
head back to the track~!
choice_data_list: Even so, you should rest today
Even so, you should rest today
Got it, please be really careful!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? But, I mean, I'm totally full of 
energy, you know?
choice_data_list: Even so, you can never be too careful.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I see. If that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Since it's a decision made by my 
Trainer who always watches over me, I 
trust you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Take it easy and rest today~ Tomorrow, 
we'll make up for today big time!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Full-power deep sleep at 100 miles an 
hour! I'm gonna rest up gooood~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Um, the rest of that menu was~~... Whoa, 
whoa, whoaa?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ow ow ow ow... Heh!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry~! I really don't think I can 
keep going~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed her injury had worsened. Gran 
Alegria was put on rest for a while...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Step by step, nice and easy, so my back 
doesn't give out...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: About this much~ and—like this!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Smooth sailing, smooth sailing! 
Let's keep this momentum goooing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Gran Alegria returned to 
training with no issues.
